services.desc: Valhalla has been training competitors since the early days of the sport. Mix Martial Arts or MMA is a blending of various forms of combat sports covering areas of striking, throwing and groundwork. Our athletes have competed in almost all forms of combat sport including Kickboxing, MMA and Jiujitsu.
